s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Shock Absorber Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: With the piston rod extended, secure the rear shock absorber assembly LH in a vise or equivalent.
Using a hacksaw or equivalent, slowly drill a hole at the position shown by the arrow in the illustration to release the gas.

item.ptxt: The gas released is colorless, odorless and harmless.
As chips may fly out due to the force of the gas, cover the hacksaw with a shop rag or equivalent while making the hole.
